Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice INV-2283 failed (3DS required)

Hi Naomi,

Our billing system just tried to charge the card on file for invoice INV-2283 (Nov usage) and Stripe returned a 'requires_action' status — 3DS authentication was required and the challenge failed. Attached is the Stripe webhook log screenshot and the invoice PDF.

Can you advise on the fastest way to get this retried? We need to clear this before EOM to avoid service interruptions on our side. If you can send a secure card-update link or reissue the invoice with a manual payment link, that would help.

Details:
- Amount: $18,420.00
- Invoice: INV-2283 (net 30)
- Stripe PaymentIntent: pi_3KxyzREDACTED (requires_action)

Thanks,
Marcus Lee
VP Finance, Acme Analytics
marcus.lee@acme-analytics.com

Attachments: invoice_INV-2283.pdf, auth-failure-screenshot.png

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2283 failed (3DS required)

Hi Marcus — thanks for the heads up and the attachments.

We can do two things quickly:
1) Send a Stripe-hosted secure card update link to the billing contact (acceptable for most enterprise cards) so the cardholder can complete the 3DS flow.
2) If you prefer, we can generate a manual pay-by-link (one-time) and you can pay immediately with whichever method you have on hand; that bypasses the original PaymentIntent but still settles the invoice.

Before I action either, I just want to confirm: do you want us to send the hosted update link to the same billing address (billing@acme-analytics.com) or to an alternate cardholder contact? Also, do you want us to temporarily hold service while we wait for the payment to avoid repeated retries from Stripe?

If you approve, I can also loop in Ben (your account owner) and our sales lead Lauren for any contract or invoice adjustments — e.g., short grace or one-off manual retry in our billing system.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Billing Operations Lead 
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: Invoice INV-2283 failed (3DS required) — need guidance on escalation

Ben / Lauren — forwarding a billing failure from Acme (invoice INV-2283). PaymentIntent requires 3DS and the cardholder failed the challenge. Marcus asked for the fastest path to clear the invoice before month-end.

Options I'm proposing:
- Send Stripe-hosted card update link (secure) to billing@acme-analytics.com so the cardholder can re-authenticate. This preserves the customer history on the PaymentIntent.
- Create a one-time pay link and mark the PaymentIntent as obsolete; customer pays immediately.
- Offer a one-time 3-day service grace while we wait for the payer to resolve (requested by the customer).

Billing notes: if we send the hosted update link, Stripe will create a new setup_intent/payment_method and we can reattempt the charge. If we reissue a pay link, it will be a separate invoice or invoice-collection session — need to confirm how Acme prefers to record the payment (original invoice vs new settlement).

Marcus is open to either route; he asked that we do the fastest thing to avoid lockout on their side. Can you confirm which approach to take and any credit/contract waivers we should offer?

Thanks — Naomi

Thanks for the ping, Naomi. Marcus, sorry for the interruption. We want to keep Acme online — plan below: 

1) Naomi: please send the Stripe-hosted secure card update link to billing@acme-analytics.com now. Use the invoice-hosted update option so the PaymentIntent is retried against the new card and 3DS can be completed.
2) Naomi: if the link is not acted on within 12 hours, create a one-time pay link for the exact invoice amount and tag it to INV-2283; we will handle accounting as a settlement for the invoice.
3) Lauren / I will approve a 48-hour grace period on service if Marcus confirms the team is in the middle of the update flow.

Also, if Acme prefers, we can initiate a card-on-file swap via their procurement portal (we support token swap with Stripe for AMEX/Corporate cards).

Marcus — Ill watch for confirmation. Naomi, please include the Stripe-hosted link and a short note on steps (1-2 bullets) so their billing team knows what to expect.

Cheers,
